title: Estimation of Random-Coefficient Dynamic Panel Data Models with a Fixed T
abstract: arXiv:2608.23988v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study dynamic linear panel data models in which the lagged outcomes and strictly exogenous covariates carry individual-specific coefficients and the time-varying errors have a flexible covariance structure. With a fixed number of time periods, we point-identify the joint distribution of the random coefficients and the structural errors under a distributional form of strict exogeneity, and propose a closed-form, multi-step estimator based on the inverse Radon transform. We establish a uniform convergence rate for the estimator of the random coefficient density, as well as uniform consistency of the estimator for the conditional density of the time-varying structural errors. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate good finite-sample performance of the estimators.

translated_title: 固定T条件下随机系数动态面板数据模型的估计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23988v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：我们研究了动态线性面板数据模型，其中滞后结果和严格外生协变量带有个体特定系数，且时变误差具有灵活的协方差结构。在固定时间期数的情况下，我们在一种严格外生性的分布形式下，点识别了随机系数与结构误差的联合分布，并提出了一种基于逆拉东变换的闭式、多步估计器。我们建立了随机系数密度估计器的统一收敛速率，以及时变结构误差条件密度估计器的统一一致性。蒙特卡洛模拟证明了估计器具有良好的有限样本性能。
tldr: 本文提出一种在固定时间期数下，基于逆拉东变换的闭式多步估计器，用于点识别和估计随机系数动态面板数据模型中随机系数与结构误差的联合分布。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a closed-form, multi-step estimator based on the inverse Radon transform to point-identify and estimate the joint distribution of random coefficients and structural errors in dynamic panel data models with a fixed T.
